info.name: dummy-payment-api (direct - NOT gateway)
info.description: Standalone payment simulator. IMPORTANT: this service is NOT registered as a gateway route - the gateway only proxies /api/** paths. It runs directly on http://localhost:9090 and is normally called server-to-server by payment-service. It is included here for manual testing only and uses {{dummy_payment_url}} instead of {{base_url}}. No auth required.
